nodes.name: Personal Time-Notes & Insight System
nodes.description: Personal notes that are always time-prefixed, reference deduplicated people cards, and can be queried in free text for synthesized text answers over the whole timeline.

nodes.name: R3
nodes.description: notes reference deduplicated shared person cards

nodes.name: R4
nodes.description: free-text question -> synthesized text answer over all notes (timeline/psych/causal)

nodes.name: R5
nodes.description: durable persistence of notes, temporal, people, links

nodes.name: R6
nodes.description: React UI to create notes + ask questions

nodes.name: R7
nodes.description: testable UI<->backend contract with its own tests

nodes.name: R9
nodes.description: model events + actions with WHO was involved and WHEN they happened

nodes.name: R10
nodes.description: track behaviour episodes a person exhibits over a time period (start..end)

nodes.name: R11
nodes.description: detect a sudden mood shift at the precise instant it occurs (from->to + trigger)

nodes.name: R12
nodes.description: query a person's behavioural timeline (events, episodes, mood shifts) over time

nodes.name: frontend
nodes.description: React single-page app: create notes + ask questions.

nodes.name: backend
nodes.description: Spring Boot microservice: notes API, temporal parsing, people dedup, LLM analysis.

nodes.name: db
nodes.description: Postgres relational store for notes, people, and links.

nodes.name: contract
nodes.description: Shared UI<->backend API contract + its conformance test.

nodes.name: Anthropic LLM API
nodes.description: Third-party LLM API powering the Embabel analysis agent.

nodes.name: embabel.models.default-llm
nodes.description: Default Embabel chat model used by the analysis agent.

nodes.name: spring.datasource.url
nodes.description: JDBC URL of the Postgres datasource.

nodes.name: Notes REST API contract
nodes.description: The testable UI<->backend REST contract for notes + query.

nodes.name: createNote
nodes.description: Contract op: create a time-prefixed note (carries CreateNoteRequest -> NoteResponse).

nodes.name: listNotes
nodes.description: Contract op: list all notes (carries -> List<NoteResponse>).

nodes.name: query
nodes.description: Contract op: ask a free-text question (carries QueryRequest -> QueryResponse).

nodes.name: linkPeople
nodes.description: Contract op: link existing people to an existing note (carries LinkPeopleRequest -> NoteResponse).

nodes.name: postgres:17
nodes.description: Postgres 17 Testcontainer pulled from docker.io for integration tests.

nodes.name: app-it
nodes.description: The app image built locally from a Dockerfile for integration tests.

nodes.name: AbstractIntegrationTest
nodes.description: Abstract base that boots the shared Testcontainers (Postgres + app image) for the integration suite.

nodes.name: createNote_persists
nodes.description: Integration test: posts a note and asserts it is persisted end-to-end.

nodes.name: notes-domain
nodes.description: Multi-module Maven module holding the pure notes domain (hexagonal core).

nodes.name: NoteDomain
nodes.description: Pure domain core for notes — no outward dependency on adapters.

nodes.name: prefixTime
nodes.description: Prefixes a note's text with its resolved temporal value.

nodes.name: SecurityConfig
nodes.description: Spring Security policy: every notes-api op requires a valid bearer token.

nodes.name: Local dev JWKS server
nodes.description: A local OAuth2 authorization server (ES256) issuing bearer tokens for local runs — no cloud IdP; ships as an optional docker-compose 'auth' service.

metadata.runtime: local dev JWKS container (docker-compose 'auth' service, optional)

nodes.name: Local JWKS endpoint
nodes.description: The local dev server's JWKS endpoint exposing the public keys used to verify token signatures.

nodes.name: NoteForm
nodes.description: Form to create a time-prefixed note with people.

nodes.name: QueryView
nodes.description: View to ask a free-text question and render the synthesized answer.

nodes.name: ApiClient
nodes.description: Typed client calling the backend notes API.

nodes.name: NoteController
nodes.description: REST controller exposing notes + query endpoints.

nodes.name: NoteService
nodes.description: Creates notes, parses temporal, links people.

nodes.name: PersonService
nodes.description: Deduplicates and resolves shared person cards.

nodes.name: RelationshipService
nodes.description: Manages people↔people relationships. BIDIRECTIONAL relationships (e.g. mother↔child, partner↔partner, sibling↔sibling) auto-insert the inverse row; UNIDIRECTIONAL ones (e.g. 'a stranger told D something') create only the single directed row.

nodes.name: TemporalParser
nodes.description: Parses free-text time prefixes into a TemporalValue.

nodes.name: AnalysisAgent
nodes.description: Embabel LLM agent that answers free-text questions over all notes.

nodes.name: Migrations
nodes.description: Schema migration owner for the data plane.

nodes.name: TemporalValue
nodes.description: Immutable temporal value: a kind plus start/end instants.

nodes.name: Person
nodes.description: Deduplicated shared person card: identity + demographic fields.

nodes.name: CreateNoteRequest
nodes.description: DTO: note text + raw temporal prefix + person refs.

nodes.name: rawText
nodes.description: Raw free-text note body incl. the time prefix.

nodes.name: occurredAt
nodes.description: Resolved temporal value the note is prefixed with.

nodes.name: personRefs
nodes.description: Names/refs of people the note involves.

nodes.name: NoteResponse
nodes.description: DTO: persisted note id + text + resolved temporal + people.

nodes.name: temporal
nodes.description: Resolved temporal value of the note.

nodes.name: people
nodes.description: Resolved deduplicated people on the note.

nodes.name: QueryRequest
nodes.description: DTO: free-text question over all notes.

nodes.name: question
nodes.description: Free-text question over the whole timeline.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.description: Synthesized text answer over all notes.

nodes.name: LinkPeopleRequest
nodes.description: DTO: link existing people to an existing note.

nodes.name: noteId
nodes.description: Id of the note to link people to.

nodes.name: personIds
nodes.description: Ids of the people to link.

nodes.name: note_person
nodes.description: Join table — many-to-many: a note can involve multiple people; a person can appear in many notes (joins note↔person).

nodes.name: person_relationship
nodes.description: Directed people↔people relationship rows realising a person↔person many-to-many; bidirectional links store an inverse row too.

nodes.name: V1__init
nodes.description: Initial schema: note, person, note_person, person_relationship.

nodes.name: deployment
nodes.description: Deployment plane: how the solution is packaged and run LOCALLY via Docker Compose.

nodes.name: app
nodes.description: The single shipping artifact: an OCI image built from ./Dockerfile that bundles BOTH the backend microservice AND the frontend SPA (served from the jar's static resources). Runs locally as the 'app' service in docker-compose, alongside a Postgres container — no cloud required.

nodes.name: local-docker
nodes.description: Local Docker Compose environment — the whole app runs in containers on the developer's machine (`docker compose up`).

nodes.name: notes-app (app)
nodes.description: The app container image built locally from ./Dockerfile — the compose 'app' service.

nodes.name: postgres:17 (db)
nodes.description: The Postgres 17 container the app runs against locally — the compose 'db' service (named volume for durable data).

nodes.name: TimelineController
nodes.description: REST controller for a person's behavioural timeline + recorded events.

nodes.name: BehaviourService
nodes.description: Records events, WHO was involved, the actions taken, and the behaviour episodes a person exhibits over a period.

nodes.name: TimelineService
nodes.description: Assembles a person's chronological timeline: events, actions, episodes, mood shifts.

nodes.name: MoodShiftDetector
nodes.description: Scans a person's behaviour episodes to detect the precise instant a sudden mood shift occurred (from->to + likely trigger).

nodes.name: EventRepository
nodes.description: Persists events, the actions within them, and who was involved.

nodes.name: BehaviourRepository
nodes.description: Persists behaviour episodes (a labelled behaviour over a period).

nodes.name: Event
nodes.description: Something that happened at a point/period in time, optionally tied to a note.

nodes.name: noteId
nodes.description: The note this event was captured from.

nodes.name: Action
nodes.description: What a specific person did within an event.

nodes.name: Involvement
nodes.description: WHO was involved in an event, and in what role.

nodes.name: BehaviourEpisode
nodes.description: A labelled behaviour a person exhibits over a time PERIOD (start..end), with intensity.

nodes.name: period
nodes.description: The PERIOD the behaviour was exhibited over.

nodes.name: MoodShift
nodes.description: A SUDDEN change of mood detected at a precise instant: from one mood to another, with the triggering event.

nodes.name: detectedAt
nodes.description: The PRECISE instant the shift was detected.

nodes.name: triggerEventId
nodes.description: The event that appears to have triggered it.

nodes.name: RecordEventRequest
nodes.description: DTO: record an event + who was involved + when.

nodes.name: PersonTimeline
nodes.description: DTO: a person's ordered timeline of events, episodes and mood shifts.

nodes.name: action
nodes.description: Actions taken within an event by a specific person.

nodes.name: involvement
nodes.description: Join: WHO (person) was involved in WHICH event, and their role (M:N).

nodes.name: behaviour_episode
nodes.description: A behaviour exhibited by a person over a period.

nodes.name: mood_shift
nodes.description: A sudden mood shift detected at a precise instant.

nodes.name: V2__behaviour
nodes.description: Behavioural/temporal schema: event, action, involvement, behaviour_episode, mood_shift.
